title: Killola, Rosscahill, Co. Galway, H91H39K
description:
O Donnellan & Joyce are delighted to offer for sale this lovely five bed detached home located in the popular and scenic townland of Killola, Rosscahill, Co. Galway.

Located approximately 5km from the village of Oughterard, and just 9km from Moycullen, with both villages offering an abundance of shops, lively pubs, bank, hotels, post office and restaurants.

In terms of schools, Oughterard & Moycullen offer several primary and secondary school options that serve the local community and surrounding Connemara areas

Oughterard Golf Course is just 3km and there is also a host of GAA, equestrian, sailing, cycling, and athletics clubs within the surrounding area.

Killola, Rosscahill is set back off the road on a large site offering complete privacy. Externally the site offers ample off-street parking and gardens to the front, side and rear.

The property is located adjacent to the proposed new greenway which will provide a superb natural recreational amenity on completion. 

Accommodation consists of a bright and spacious entrance hall, a lounge room with feature wood flooring and insert stove, a large open plan kitchen and dining room with feature solid fuel stove with stone surround.  

Also on the ground floor is the main bathroom and three large bedrooms two of which offer en suite bathrooms.  A utility and laundry room to the rear completes the ground floor.

On the first floor the property offers a storage room and two large bedrooms, both with plumbing available for en-suite bathrooms.
 
The beautiful Lough Corrib is close by, public slips and extensive moorings available in the village of Oughterard, making it the ideal location for any fishing & boating enthusiast. 

Known as the Gateway to Connemara via Maam Cross with large numbers of visitors flocking to the area each year.  It is renowned for its natural beauty with walking routes, boating facilities and other outdoor leisure activities, offering all that one could require in terms of modern day living. 

Homes in this idyllic location rarely come to the market, making this an ideal property for any buyer looking for a tranquil rural lifestyle but still near all essential amenities.
